countries_thin_or_null: Yukon — solid budget and TFF share documentation; bureau of statistics exists but thinner own statistical production than provinces
Northwest Territories — solid budget and ~70% TFF documentation; bureau of statistics active
Nunavut — solid budget and ~68-70% TFF/federal-transfer documentation; bureau of statistics still developing relative to the other two

proposed_reports.title: Yukon Main Estimates (Operation and Maintenance and Capital Estimates)
proposed_reports.description: Annual Main Estimates setting out the Government of Yukon's planned operation-and-maintenance and capital expenditures and revenues for the fiscal year, prepared under the direction of Management Board for the Legislative Assembly.

proposed_reports.title: Yukon Fiscal Outlook (and companion Economic Outlook)
proposed_reports.description: Annual fiscal and economic outlook documents accompanying the Yukon Budget that project revenues (including federal transfers), expenditures, surplus/deficit and net debt over a multi-year horizon.

proposed_reports.title: Northwest Territories Main Estimates and Budget Address / Fiscal Review
proposed_reports.description: Annual Main Estimates, Budget Address and Fiscal Review papers setting out the Government of the Northwest Territories' planned revenues (including the Grant from Canada), operating expenditures and fiscal outlook.

proposed_reports.title: Nunavut Main Estimates and Fiscal and Economic Indicators / Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual Main Estimates, Budget Address and Fiscal and Economic Indicators documents setting out the Government of Nunavut's planned revenues (Territorial Formula Financing and other federal transfers), expenditures and fiscal outlook.

proposed_reports.title: Yukon Bureau of Statistics
proposed_reports.publisher: Yukon Bureau of Statistics (Government of Yukon)
proposed_reports.description: Territorial statistical agency that compiles and publishes Yukon-specific population estimates, economic accounts, labour-force indicators, CPI for Whitehorse, retail sales and annual statistical reviews, drawing on Statistics Canada data and its own surveys.

proposed_reports.title: NWT Bureau of Statistics
proposed_reports.publisher: NWT Bureau of Statistics (Government of the Northwest Territories)
proposed_reports.description: Territorial statistical agency responsible for the NWT statistical program; publishes population estimates, GDP, labour-force activity, CPI, community statistics and socio-economic scans, frequently using Statistics Canada source data.

proposed_reports.title: Nunavummit Kiglisiniartiit (Nunavut Bureau of Statistics)
proposed_reports.description: Nunavut's central statistical agency; collects, analyses and disseminates population, labour-force, CPI (Iqaluit), GDP and community statistics for the territory, operating under the Statistics Act (Nunavut) and partnering with Statistics Canada.
